items.title: Microduck 用 Isaac Lab 和 Newton 完成避障的仿真到现实流程
items.summary: Microduck 团队展示了在 Isaac Lab 和 Newton 物理引擎中训练避障策略、再迁移到真实机器人的工作流程。
items.lede: Microduck 团队公布了一套用 Isaac Lab 和 Newton 训练避障、再迁移到真机的流程。
analysis: Microduck 团队发布了基于 Isaac Lab 和 Newton 的避障仿真到现实（Sim2Real）流程。
该流程先在仿真中训练避障策略，再部署到真实机器人上。
材料未给出成功率、测试次数等具体数字，实际效果尚待更多验证。

en.title: Microduck completes sim-to-real obstacle avoidance workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
en.summary: The Microduck team demonstrated a workflow that trains obstacle avoidance in Isaac Lab and Newton, then transfers the policy to a real robot.
en.lede: Microduck has shared a pipeline that trains obstacle avoidance with Isaac Lab and Newton and moves it to a physical robot.

en.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences through reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.
en.lede: GPT-6 models design proteins through reasoning and code, with lab tests finding binding evidence across five targets.

items.title: 谷歌搜索 AI 模式接入 Drive 和 Wallet，可读取个人数据作答
items.summary: 谷歌把 AI 模式中的个人智能功能扩展到 Drive、Wallet 和 Gemini 应用，让搜索能调用用户已存在谷歌生态里的数据。
items.lede: 谷歌搜索的 AI 模式新增个人数据接入，可读取 Drive 和 Wallet 中的信息来回答问题。
analysis: 谷歌宣布，搜索的 AI 模式现在可以接入 Drive 和 Wallet，并在 Gemini 应用中提供个人智能功能。
这意味着 AI 回答可以结合用户自己存储的文件和钱包信息，而不只依赖公开网页。
目前没有公布具体可用范围或上线时间等细节。

en.title: Google Search's AI Mode can now pull from Drive and Wallet for personalized answers
en.summary: Google is extending Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, letting Search draw on data users already keep inside Google's ecosystem.
en.lede: Google Search's AI Mode can now use information from Drive and Wallet to answer questions.
analysis: Google said AI Mode in Search can now connect to Drive and Wallet, and Personal Intelligence is also coming to the Gemini app.
This lets AI answers draw on a user's own stored files and wallet information, not just public web pages.
Google did not share specifics such as availability limits or a rollout timeline.

items.original_title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
